simple.meaning: סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה (çûwmᵉpôwnᵉyâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a bagpipe (with a double pipe).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה (H5481) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 3:5, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה (H5481) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in סוּמְפּוֹנְיָה (H5481) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.full: H5481. sumponeyah סוּמְמֹּנְיָה noun feminine , bag-pipe, or double pipe, or Pan's pipe (see GFM JBL, 1905, 166 ff. ) (Late Hebrew Levy NHWB iii. 492 ; Late Hebrew Aramaic סִימְלאסמּוֺן is tube , especially vein, artery Id ib. 513 ; loan-word from (late) Greek συμφωνία , Krauss ii. 376, 390 Bev 41 Dr Dan 3:5 Nes MM 37 (hence also later Latin symphonia , Ital. zampogna ), Prince KB 9230 ); — absolute ׳ס 3:5 , 15 , = סיפניה Kt, סוּמֹּנְיָה Qr 3:10 (Syriac id. ; compare Palmyrene ספון = σύμφωνος , in agreement, Lzb 330 GACooke Inscr. 338 ).
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) or סוּמְפֹּנְיָה ; (Aramaic), or סִיפֹנְיָא ; (Daniel 3:10) (Aramaic), of Greek origin;

occurrences.englishText: that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.

You, O king, have made a decree, that every man that hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, shall fall down and worship the golden image;

Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, good; but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the middle of a burning fiery furnace. Who is that god that will deliver you out of my hands?”
